title: Audio Video Preview
description: Watch and listen to what the stream makes: wire a picture into video and a sound into audio. Either can be left unwired.

inputs.name: video
inputs.description: The picture to watch, letterboxed to the area, with its size, frame rate and timecode.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The sound to hear, played on the default output device and drawn as one meter per channel.

fit.description: Fit the picture to the area, or show it at its own size.

safe_areas.description: Draw the action and title safe areas over the picture.
